STAGE: constraint analysis before writing the idea
GOAL: choose a coupling position that (a) satisfies the scope contract, (b) is not one of the mechanisms already tried in rounds 20261028_233100_128 / 20261029_030015_260 / 20261029_093253_576, (c) respects the round objective (certificate-gated, precision-first, levels 1..L-1 bit-identical, derivable constants only).
READ: the task text only (no repository access; read tool is permission-denied and there is no shell). Occupied design-space slots inferred from the record: codebook update (poincare-frechet-successor-codebook), per-level curvature from prefix transitions (CURVCTRL-SID), radial behaviour-ranked assignment (BRad-RQ), Lorentz successor profile, behaviour cones, geodesic boosts, MoE branch curvature, MIXCURV-FIBRE, TSG-SID.
OBSERVED: every occupied slot acts either on the codebook, on per-level curvature, or on a radial coordinate. None of them uses a MEASURED hyperbolicity of the training behaviour graph as the admissible tolerance of a discrete move, and none gates the move set by a Stage-3-demand statistic computed from training next-item events.
REASONING: so the free slot I take is the CERTIFICATE itself: (i) curvature derived from the Gromov four-point defect delta_G of the training transition graph (measured, not tuned), (ii) the same delta re-expressed as a radius-dependent local hyperbolic resolution delta_loc(i) that becomes the margin a move must beat, (iii) an additional Stage-3-relevance condition (per-prefix deepest-token entropy above the TRAIN median AND target-cell per-item next-item mass above source cell) to fix the earlier failure where a necessary-but-not-sufficient certificate moved one third of the catalogue, (iv) a capacity cap anchored to the frozen Stage-2 cell sizes so coverage cannot be bought by concentration.
OPEN: nothing blocking; the write-up follows in the next record.

FINAL ANSWER (record for the framework; the full formatted block is printed in the response).

IDEA: GROMOV4-MARGIN-GATE-SID
One-liner: post-Stage-2, precision-first relabel of the DEEPEST RQ level only, inside each fixed prefix, accepted by (i) a hyperbolic margin derived from the measured Gromov four-point defect delta_G of the TRAIN transition graph, (ii) a TRAIN next-item-demand gate (per-prefix deepest-token entropy above its TRAIN median AND per-item mass in target cell above source cell), (iii) a capacity cap equal to the frozen Stage-2 maximum cell size.
Chain used: TRAIN transitions -> symmetrised graph -> BFS hop metric -> 16-anchor distance vector -> exp_0 into Poincare ball with kappa=-1/delta_G^2 -> behaviour-smoothed hyperbolic point (weighted Karcher mean over the item's top-32 transition neighbours) -> cell centroids -> move rule.
Coupling equation: T(i,cell) = sum_{j in cell} w_ij exp(-d_P(y_i,y_j;kappa)) / sum_j w_ij exp(-d_P(y_i,y_j;kappa)), accepted jointly with d_P(y_i,m_target)+delta_loc(i) < d_P(y_i,m_source).
Additional Stage-3 condition (the one the earlier round lacked): H(c_L|pi) > median_pi H(c_L|pi) on TRAIN next-item events, and u(pi,c') > u(pi,c) with u = per-item next-item mass of the cell; both measured on the training split, plus cap(pi) = frozen max cell size. No tuned constant: delta_G measured, kappa=1/max(delta_G,1), median gate, cap from frozen geometry, temperature=1 because distances are in hop units, seed fixed 20261031.
Guarantees: levels 1..L-1 and both codebooks bit-identical, so the validation L1 negative hit rate MUST be numerically identical before/after; that equality is asserted in code as a falsification check (a nonzero delta means the relabel leaked upward). The diagnostic that can change and that we report is the (L-1)-prefix negative hit rate plus per-prefix and per-item deepest-token conditional entropy.
Cost: 0 added FLOPs across the 72,000 Stage-2 steps (24/epoch x 3000) and 0 across Stage-3; one-time precompute ~2-4 CPU-minutes (2048 BFS, 262,144-quadruple four-point sample, ~1e5 exp maps, sparse T over <=32 neighbours/item).
Switches exist (behaviour-off: neighbours empty, w=0, H-gate/u-condition disabled -> pure curved nearest-centroid with the same cap and margin; geometry-off: c=0 branch -> identity exp/log, Euclidean distance, arithmetic mean, chordal delta_loc; both-on: full). No arm is trained this round.
Prediction/observables: moved fraction far below the previous 1/3 (expected 2-15%), entropy down under eligible prefixes, Stage-3 test_recall@10 > 0.065 is the only judgement.
Main risks: delta_G large (graph not tree-like) -> kappa small -> geometry nearly Euclidean; behaviour graph too sparse -> few admissible moves; Karcher shrinkage toward origin making the margin too permissive; Stage-3 insensitive to the deepest token.
